display_name: Marketo: Add Named Account List Members
description: Add up to 300 named accounts, by marketoGUID, to one Marketo named account list (POST /rest/v1/namedAccountList/{list_id}/namedAccounts.json). Async write: poll check_marketo_job_status for per-record added/skipped status and reasons. Vendor RBAC decides what the API user may write.
embedding_description: Add existing Marketo named accounts to one named account list (ABM account list membership), up to 300 marketoGUIDs per batch. Async write returns per-record added or skipped status with vendor reasons. Membership only: no account is created. Distinct from remove_named_account_list_members and sync_named_account_lists.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo named account list members add job dispatched
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id and status 'queued'. The completed job result is Marketo's per-record results array (seq, marketoGUID or id, status, reasons), row_count and tallies (status -> count).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This changes vendor state. A queued job is not vendor success: poll check_marketo_job_status, then report the tallies and any skipped records with their reasons.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Add named accounts to a Marketo named account list on the configured instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: refused at dispatch before any vendor call (missing or malformed parameters, more than 300 entries, an action/dedupe_by/delete_by value Marketo does not define, a list_id that is empty or a relative path segment, or a named_account_ids entry that is not a non-empty string). On the finished job: marketo.permission_denied (vendor 603 or HTTP 403) means the API user's Role lacks the Access API permission; marketo.auth_failed (601/602 after one re-mint, or HTTP 401) means the credential was rejected; marketo.validation_failed and other vendor codes carry Marketo's own message. A transport fault after dispatch may follow a vendor mutation.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.permission_denied: grant Read-Write Named Account under Admin > Users & Roles > Roles > the API role > Access API, then retry. Read the records back with get_named_account_list_members before retrying a write that ended in a transport fault.
